items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses Bunk Johnson and Ma Rainey in detail, but John Chilton is only mentioned by the interviewer as the author of a reference book ('Chilton book', 'John Chilton's Who's Who In Jazz'). The interviewee does not describe any personal interaction or relationship with John Chilton.

ctx.x: And he was a very articulate musician. I can remember that, every note he played was very distinct, that was his style, you know. So when he suddenly left the Louisiana area, as I said, and I didn't know where he was, then later I think he was discovered, and he came out to California. I think he was around San Francisco. And this was I think where he was when he passed, if I'm not mistaken.
I just opened up the Chilton book* here and it says here that he was born on Laurel Street in New Orleans, the 27th of December 1879, and he died in New Iberia.
Yeah, well New Iberia, you see, he lived in New Iberia. As I said, that was his home for an awfully long time.
